design: Frozen .1-penalty top8 span, both seeds, all168 factorial swaps and MLP/joint paths. Teacher-informed per-example Fisher weighted least-squares coefficients, centered at zero MLP change. Reference distribution weights center logit Jacobians and exact target logit difference. Ridge=1e-6 mean Fisher eigenvalue. Exact quadratic norm-constrained solution via eigensystem/bisection; radii1x and2x teacher MLP change norm, all retained. No model training.
finite_differences: Central differences per orthonormal span vector at .01 and .005 teacher-effect norm. Half step used; full-step derivative discrepancy reported for every case, no filtering.
comparators: Zero MLP change, exact teacher, actual top8, Euclidean projection, Fisher radius1 and radius2. All candidates evaluated in nonlinear live model; local quadratic fit is not a guarantee of globally best KL.
scope: An oracle using evaluation teacher outputs, not a deployable or learned representation. Output KL measures distributions at the final token. Norm budgets limit arbitrary off-manifold compensation; do not establish on-manifold validity.
